reason: CAS 109-01-3 (N-methylpiperazine, CN1CCNCC1) is a derivative/salt-equivalent of piperazine core structure, but more precisely it is a substituted piperazine. The piperazine ring with N-methyl substitution matches piperazine scope (C1CNCCN1) as the free base skeleton is piperazine; 1-methylpiperazine is commonly classified as a piperazine derivative covered under 'Piperazine and its salts' regulatory scope.
